## Purpose and scope

What user problem does this solve? Link the issue and any dependent PRs.
List shared interfaces and feature owners affected.

## Triage and regression checks

Use [Bug triage and prevention](https://github.com/AY2627S1-CS2103T-F08-3/tp/blob/master/docs/BugTriage.md) for the affected areas.
Mark each relevant risk passed, failed, not run, or not applicable with a reason.

| Relevant risk / scenario | Evidence (test or manual steps) | Result / remaining decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Input boundaries, realistic mistakes, overflow, symbols | | |
| Duplicates, case/search, validation and error usefulness | | |
| UI readability and terminal output | | |
| Manual JSON edits, reload, atomic failure and state preservation | | |
| User Guide consistency and product limitations | | |

## Verification

- Commands run and test totals (including failures/errors/skips):
- Actual GUI inspection for layout changes, or reason not applicable:
- Backward compatibility and cross-owner regression evidence:
- Unresolved risks / proposed severity or scope decisions:

Do not treat documentation of a restriction as proof that it is useful or out of scope.
Do not claim complete GUI verification from skipped UI tests.
